title: Phase Stake (YIELD LST, Solana) — SPL stake pool on Sanctum multi-validator program
closed_reasons: Standard audited Sanctum multi-validator SPL stake pool program (SPMBzs...) — no unguarded value instruction
All deposits mint at exact NAV (floor favors pool); deposit->withdraw-stake round trip loses the 0.1% withdrawal fee (simulated)
Instant SOL withdrawals gated by sol_withdraw_authority (phaseUTHS... keypair): unsigned attempt fails SignatureMissing (simulated)
Reserve cannot be drained via WithdrawStake while validator stake exists (simulated)
Privileged instructions (SetFee/AddValidatorToPool) reject a fresh attacker (WrongManager/WrongStaker, simulated)
Freshness gates (last_update_epoch >= clock.epoch + per-entry freshness) block stale-rate/donation MEV
YIELD has effectively no market (Raydium pool tvl 0; ~$2.8k/24h) — no meaningful below-NAV buy-and-redeem arbitrage
F-1 precondition absent today: the only validator-list record is Active (no Deactivating* record); the precondition can only be created by the staker

poc.note: 7/8 chain-native simulateTransaction cases reach their expected outcome (A,B,G success; C1,C2,D,E,F fail at the intended gate). Sim H (DepositStake with a freshly delegated source) passes all pool-program gates without any authority signature and then fails at the stake-program merge (Custom:6 MergeMismatch) because a just-delegated source is still activating — a state precondition, not a pool gate.

conditional_paths.title: Deactivating-validator accounting bug in unpatched SPL stake-pool v1.0.0 (fixed upstream in v2.2.0)
conditional_paths.mechanism: UpdateValidatorListBalance (permissionless, no_merge=false) records 0 lamports for a DeactivatingValidator/DeactivatingAll record whose stake is still active; UpdateStakePoolBalance then understates total_lamports by X; deposits mint at the collapsed price and gain becomes backed when the stake merges into the reserve.
conditional_paths.precondition: A Deactivating* record exists — created only by the staker's RemoveValidatorFromPool (privileged; routine validator rotation).
conditional_paths.live_evidence: validator list vec_len=1, record status=Active at slot 457272609; stale ReadyForRemoval bytes from epochs 953-954 show prior rotations
conditional_paths.evidence: code reading sp2_processor.rs:2469-2496 + upstream v2.2.0 diff (up_v22_processor.rs) + analysis/program-audit.md; local solana-test-validator PoC ci/f1/ (cloned accounts + crafted precondition, fresh-keypair attack tx)
conditional_paths.remediation: Sanctum program upgrade to v2.2.0+ behavior
